children: Torrid Holdings Inc. reported second-quarter 2026 results with revenue of $231.7M, down from $262.8M a year earlier, while net income rose to $5.18M and diluted earnings per share were $0.05.
Revenue was $231.7M for Q2 2026, compared with $262.8M in the year‑ago quarter; YoY change (11.8%).
Net income was $5.18M for Q2 2026, compared with $1.57M in the year‑ago quarter; YoY change 230.4%.
Diluted EPS was $0.05 for Q2 2026, compared with $0.02 in the year‑ago quarter; YoY change 150.0%.
Net sales declined roughly 10–12% year over year for both the quarter and the six‑month period, driven by lower average transaction values despite stable transaction counts.
The company continued an accelerated shift to e‑commerce, closing 177 stores across fiscal 2025 through Q2 FY2026 to better align with online demand.
Gross margin improved modestly, aided by approximately $11.1M in tariff refunds and lower store-related costs, though gains were partly offset by increased promotional activity.
SG&A expense decreased about 10–12% year over year due to payroll and store cost reductions tied to store optimization and a reallocation of marketing spend toward online channels.
